item.title: EUR/USD Falls as Fed Signals Prolonged High Rates
item.description: The EUR/USD pair dropped to a three-month low after Federal Reserve officials signalled interest rates would remain elevated. USD strength weighed on the euro.

item.title: Crude Oil Prices Surge on OPEC Supply Cut Extension
item.description: Crude oil jumped above $90 per barrel after OPEC extended its production cuts. Gold also advanced as risk sentiment deteriorated.

item.title: S&P 500 Hits Record High on Strong Earnings Season
item.description: The S&P 500 index closed at a record high as corporate earnings beat analyst expectations across technology and consumer sectors.
